question: In which event at the 2023 U-20 Asian Athletics Championships did Siddharth Choudhary win a gold medal for India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shot put**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Siddharth Choudhary** won a gold medal in the **shot put** event at the **2023 U-20 Asian Athletics Championships**.
 
• This achievement highlights India's growing presence and competitiveness in the field of athletics on the international stage.
 
• The event saw participation from several promising young athletes from various Asian countries, making Siddharth's victory a notable accomplishment.
 
• Siddharth's performance in the shot put event was marked by excellent technique and strength, which secured him the top position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **U-20 Asian Athletics Championships** is a biennial event that aims to provide a platform for young athletes to showcase their talents and gain international experience.
 
• India has consistently performed well in these championships, with several athletes winning medals in various disciplines.
 
• The shot put event involves athletes throwing a heavy spherical object, called a "shot," as far as possible, and it requires a combination of strength, technique, and agility.
 
• Siddharth Choudhary's victory adds to India's legacy in athletics and serves as an inspiration for other young athletes in the country.
